latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — instantly turn text prompts into shareable videos.

- Convert up to 150-word product descriptions into 1080p AI-generated videos, ready in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, iterative tweaks, and direct file uploads.
- No timeline editing or export settings needed: just describe your result for automatic video creation.
- Built-in free token system: anonymous users get 100 credits valid for 7 days.
- Exports available in MP4 and other common formats; progress and status handled automatically.
- Error handling covers token issues, credit shortages, file problems, and rate limits.
